audience: IT and identity teams who check SSO connections, directory sync and invitations in WorkOS

useCases.title: Check which organizations have an SSO connection
useCases.text: List the organizations of the environment. Then list their SSO connections, filtered by organization or state.

useCases.title: Find users synced from a directory
useCases.text: List the directories, then read one to see its sync status. List the users synced from a directory, filtered by email.

useCases.title: Review pending invitations
useCases.text: List the invitations, filtered by organization or email. Read the organization memberships to see who is active.

useCases.title: Check the events of a time range
useCases.text: List WorkOS events in a time range, such as dsync.user.created or connection.activated.

useCases.title: Start a directory sync
useCases.text: Start a Directory Sync so WorkOS pulls the latest users and groups from the identity provider. Repeating it is safe.

useCases.title: Revoke a pending invitation
useCases.text: Revoke a pending invitation so its link stops working. This cannot be undone, and a new invitation is then needed.
